name: Deeper Depravity
notes: Bosses can be raised and used by the player as new lite units: the boss's sprite at a smaller size (to fit through hallways), much less health, normal follow/attack AI and one or two of the boss's own attacks (each boss's real AI is scripted around its arena). Health decays slower than other summons. Every boss except the stationary ones: the Harbingers (each judge), the Bandit King (the roaming encounter and the final fight; not his mirror clones), the Bone Serpent, the Spider Queen, Dace Arden, the Avatar and the five Heaven Spirits. Left out: the turrets (the four totem poles, Arista, the Face) and the bell ghost shooter in Dace Arden's arena (a prop tagged as a boss).
summary: Increase chance of elite and boss intact bodies
